scope: --demo edition: original _DEMO weapon, bomb, pickup and first-level branches selected at runtime; demo archive layout

retail_evidence.purpose: Single archive: 1364 resources, worlds/demo_01.dat and demo_02.dat (DAT v56), cres.dll Ver 1.0 (Build 178) with 43 strings (ids 0..48, no IDS_MENU_*), cshell.dll DEMO v1.0 (Build 108) with menu labels compiled in.

references.purpose: The demo configurations define _DEMO for the server DLL (ClientShellDLL.dsp does the same).
ObtainWeapon IsDemoWeapon player gate after the slot search, no bomb construction, AddInventoryWeapon returning CHWEAP_NOTAVAIL, IsDemoWeapon list.
ItemPickupWeapon MID_INITIALUPDATE removes bomb pickups and breaks before multiplayer/USRFLG_GLOW.
COMMAND_DETONATE is compiled out of the demo.
MenuNewGame sFirstLevel Demo_01; EndGame exit, loading screens and other unconnected demo branches.
Source demo version string DEMO v1.0a (Build 109), newer than the shipped client.
_DEMO main menu: PRIMEGIBS label and Bloodbath/Credits/Quit splash screens (Quit exits without confirmation).
_DEMO single player: no load/save/custom level; Chosen shows screens/modes.pcx.
Splash_SetState/Splash_OnKeyDown: full-screen PCX dismissed by ESC/SPACE/RETURN, back to GS_MENU or shutdown.

adaptations: The compile-time _DEMO define is a runtime edition fixed by mount_game and carried by Resources copies.
A pickup removed during its own initial update skips model placement; the source configured the doomed object, which checked transforms reject.
No menu text is embedded: demo labels are read from the user's demo cshell.dll at verified offsets.
Splash screens keep the menu canvas aspect instead of stretching to the window.

demo_client_evidence.file: cshell.dll inside B2Demo.rez (719872 bytes, DEMO v1.0 (Build 108) at file offset 0x932d4)
demo_client_evidence.purpose: Data-only inspection, never executed: the 24 menu literals at .data offsets 0x94104-0x945ac each have exactly one push reference in .text, in source Build order (CMenuMain 0x100520f4.., CMenuOptions 0x10052337.., CMenuSinglePlayer 0x1005271e.., CMenuDifficulty 0x1004e4fe.., CMenuDisplay 0x1004ee68.., CMenuAudio 0x100529bb..). The splash paths screens/bloodbath.pcx, info.pcx and modes.pcx follow them.
